author: Priyanka Patel
title: Honda at Japan Mobility Show 2025: What to Expect
text:
Honda to Showcase Future of Mobility – From EVs to Jets – at Japan Mobility Show 2025 A comprehensive display of Honda’s vision for the future of transportation, encompassing land, sea, and air, is slated for the Japan Mobility Show 2025.
Honda is preparing a significant presence at the Japan Mobility Show 2025, promising a glimpse into its evolving approach to mobility and its commitment to innovation. The automaker intends to exhibit a diverse range of products, reflecting its long-held ambition to create solutions that enhance people’s lives and contribute to society.
Driven by Dreams and Original Technology Since its inception, Honda has operated on a foundation of ingenuity, fueled by the aspirations of its employees and a dedication to pioneering technologies. “Honda has always been driven by the dreams of honda associates and creating mobility products using its original technologies and ideas,” a company release stated. This ethos will be central to the exhibit, designed to immerse visitors in the world of dream-inspiring mobility products.
Did you know? – Honda Motor Co. was founded in 1948, initially producing motorized bicycles. It quickly expanded into motorcycles and automobiles,becoming a global automotive leader. A Broad Spectrum of Innovation the showcase will extend beyond traditional automobiles and motorcycles, encompassing mobility products for marine and aviation applications. Visitors will have the prospect to experience the latest advancements in Honda’s automotive and motorcycle lineups, alongside a return appearance of the full-size interior mockup of the HondaJet Elite II light business jet. Frist displayed at the 2023 Japan Mobility Show, the mockup allows potential customers to experience the spacious and luxurious cabin firsthand.
Pro tip: – The Japan Mobility Show, formerly the Tokyo Motor Show, has evolved to showcase a wider range of transportation solutions, including robotics and related technologies. The Dawn of the 0 Series EVs A key highlight of Honda’s exhibit will be the Honda 0 Series EV models. These groundbreaking electric vehicles, scheduled for a global market launch in 2026, represent a significant step forward in the company’s electrification strategy. Details regarding the 0 Series EVs remain limited, but their inclusion signals Honda’s commitment to a sustainable future.
Why: Honda is showcasing its future mobility vision, encompassing EVs, jets, and marine products, to demonstrate its commitment to innovation and a sustainable future. Who: Honda Motor Co.is the exhibitor, targeting potential customers, industry professionals, and the general public. What: The exhibit will feature the Honda 0 Series EVs , the HondaJet Elite II mockup, and advancements in automotive and motorcycle technology. How: Through an immersive booth design and product displays, Honda aims to connect visitors with its technologies and vision. The exhibit is scheduled to be fully detailed in a news release and on the official show website toward the end of September, with the 0 Series EVs launching globally in 2026.
Reader question: – What specific technologies do you anticipate will be central to Honda’s 0 Series EVs, and how might they differ from current EV offerings? Experiential Design and Future Details The honda booth is specifically designed to provide an immersive experience, allowing visitors to connect with the company’s vision and the technologies that underpin it.According to a senior official, the exhibit will enable visitors to “experience dream-inspiring mobility products Honda created with its original technologies and ideas while being driven by its own dreams.”
A complete list of items to be featured in the honda exhibit will be released via a news release and the official Honda Japan Mobility Show 2025 special website toward the end of September. This announcement is anticipated to provide further insight into the innovative solutions Honda will be presenting at the show.
